extension.summary: Skip intros, recaps, previews and credits with community data and Kodi 22 chapters.
extension.description: IntroSkip combines IntroDB daily open data and API lookups, TheIntroDB v4 and Kodi 22 native chapters to find intros, recaps, previews and credits. It resolves titles through keyless Cinemeta and uses playback duration to help match release versions. IntroDB data is indexed locally and refreshed when its daily manifest changes. Choose Ask or Auto for each supported segment; explicit Kodi chapters take priority and automatic skipping remains conservative.
extension.news: 0.0.30 improves updates and removal: skip dialogs are created only when needed, native window references are released on shutdown, playback workers are joined within a bounded time, and SQLite index operations are interrupted when Kodi stops the service. Detection behavior is unchanged.
